fields.statement: At de5efa519 ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run CPUProfile -v -count=1: TestDaemonCPUProfilePassedToDrivers PASS. The test drives daemonResume (the daemon starting a run's driver) with a fake Detach and Getenv; with RHIZA_CPUPROFILE=/dir/daemon.pprof the driver Program's Env holds RHIZA_CPUPROFILE=/dir/daemon.pprof.01RUNID, and with it unset no RHIZA_CPUPROFILE entry. Read the diff: daemonDetachNoRex, which every daemon-detached driver goes through, appends RHIZA_CPUPROFILE=<daemon path>.<name>; Program.Env is set over the inherited environment, so it replaces the daemon's own value and the driver never overwrites the daemon's profile. For a start, name is the start log (<change set>.start-N) since the run ID is drawn later by the child, still a file unique to that driver. go vet and gofmt clean on internal/api.
